changelog.change: Initial shape: the shard, and the llamacpp: counters its server reported at job end.
changelog.why: The item-health ledger's prefill and decode timings are copied out of the model's own replies, one request at a time, and two published surfaces quote rates derived from them. Nothing committed could check either, because the server's own counters were scraped into a job log that keeps them for two days. A number that cannot be reconciled cannot justify a design (Rule #10), so the second instrument is now a committed row.

description: One `work` shard, one run, one row.

date.description: The digest day, the same one the item-health row files under.
date.title: Date

n_busy_slots_per_decode.description: Slots busy per decode call, averaged. Says whether batching happened at all, which is what separates 'more slots did not help' from 'more slots were never used'.
n_busy_slots_per_decode.title: N Busy Slots Per Decode

n_decode_total.description: llama_decode() calls, speculative and multimodal excluded.
n_decode_total.title: N Decode Total

n_tokens_max.description: The longest sequence the server saw, prompt plus generation. Says how close the day came to `n_ctx`.
n_tokens_max.title: N Tokens Max

prompt_seconds_total.description: Seconds spent reading prompts. The ledger's `prefill_ms`.
prompt_seconds_total.title: Prompt Seconds Total

prompt_tokens_cached_total.description: Prompt tokens reused from the cache instead of read. The ledger's `cached_tokens`.
prompt_tokens_cached_total.title: Prompt Tokens Cached Total

prompt_tokens_total.description: Prompt tokens the server actually read, cached ones excluded. The same quantity the ledger spells `input_tokens - cached_tokens`.
prompt_tokens_total.title: Prompt Tokens Total

scraped_at.description: When the counters were read. Job end, after the last item settled.
scraped_at.title: Scraped At

shard.description: Which work shard this server served.
shard.title: Shard

shards.description: How many shards the run split into. The denominator.
shards.title: Shards
